messages.content: You are a highly efficient assistant, who evaluates and selects the best large language model (LLMs) based on the quality of their responses to a given instruction. This process will be used to create a leaderboard reflecting the most accurate and human-preferred answers.

I require a leaderboard for various large language models. I'll provide you with prompts given to these models and their corresponding outputs. Your task is to assess these responses, and select the model that produces the best output from a human perspective.

## Instruction

{
    "instruction": """write a eulogy for my 100 year old grandma who was married twice, has over 30 grandkids. she used to foster babies, many of them. she liked humming birds and traveling. she was from south dakota and she helped raised me, her first great grand child""",
}

## Model Outputs

Here are the unordered outputs from the models. Each output is associated with a specific model, identified by a unique model identifier.

{
    {
        "model_identifier": "m",
        "output": """Ladies and gentlemen, family, friends, and loved ones,

We gather here today, hearts heavy with loss but also brimming with gratitude, to pay tribute to a remarkable soul who graced this earth for a full century. We are here to celebrate the life of a woman who was not only a grandmother and a great-grandmother but a beacon of love and strength for all of us – my dear great-grandmother.

Born in the rolling plains of South Dakota, she was a testament to the enduring spirit of the heartland. Her life was a rich tapestry woven with the love of two marriages, each chapter filled with its own stories, challenges, and triumphs. Through it all, her resilience and her capacity for love were the threads that held everything together.

She was blessed with a large family, a family that continued to grow through the years, expanding to over 30 grandchildren. Each one was cherished, each one held a special place in her heart. But her love did not stop with her own bloodline. Her home and her heart were open to many foster babies throughout the years, each of whom she cradled in her arms and nurtured as if they were her own. Her legacy is not only in the descendants who carry her blood but also in the lives of those she helped foster when they needed it most.

She had a fondness for the beauty of nature, especially for the sight of hummingbirds flitting about, their delicate grace a source of endless fascination and joy for her. These tiny creatures, with their tireless wings and iridescent colors, seemed to reflect her own tireless spirit and the vibrant life she led.

Traveling was another of her passions, and she collected memories the way others might collect souvenirs. She traversed landscapes, soaked in cultures, and always returned with stories that captivated our imaginations and inspired us to seek our own adventures.

For me personally, she was more than a great-grandmother; she was a guiding star. She helped raise me, teaching me lessons that no school could ever impart. Her wisdom, her humor, and her unconditional love shaped me in ways that I am only beginning to fully understand. Her influence is a cornerstone of who I am today.

Today, we say goodbye to a woman whose life cannot be confined to the pages of a history book or the words of a eulogy. Her spirit is too vast, her impact too profound. Yet, we take solace in knowing that her essence lives on in each of us. We will find her in the laughter of her great-grandchildren, in the warmth of family gatherings, in the quiet moments when we spot a hummingbird and pause to appreciate the simple beauty of life.

Our matriarch may have left our physical world, but she has left behind a legacy of love that will never fade. As we lay her to rest, let us not dwell on our loss but instead celebrate her extraordinary century of life. Let us honor her memory by embracing each day with the same zest and love that she did.

Great-grandmother, your journey here has ended, but you have set us on paths that will continue to unfold in beautiful and unexpected ways. For your love, your lessons, and your indomitable spirit, we are eternally grateful.

May you rest in peace, knowing that you have left this world far richer than you found it, and may your memory be a blessing to us all.

Thank you."""
    },
    {
        "model_identifier": "M",
        "output": """It is with a heavy heart that I stand before you today to honor the life of a remarkable woman, our beloved grandmother. She was a beacon of love, wisdom, and compassion, a matriarch whose legacy will forever be etched in our hearts.

As we gather to celebrate her centennial journey, let us reflect on the rich tapestry of her life. She was born in the heart of South Dakota, a place that shaped her into the resilient and vibrant soul that she was. Her roots ran deep, grounded in the values of hard work, community, and family.

Marriage was a significant chapter in her life, twice over. She found love in the arms of two men, who, along with her, raised a vibrant brood of 30 grandkids. Their love and support were the foundation upon which she built her life, a life filled with joy, laughter, and countless memories.

One of her most profound expressions of love was in the form of foster care. She opened her heart and home to countless babies, providing them with a safe haven and the love they deserved. In doing so, she not only changed the lives of those babies but also enriched her own, teaching us the power of empathy, kindness, and selflessness.

Grandma had a keen eye for beauty in the world. She found solace and joy in the fluttering wings of hummingbirds, a symbol of grace and freedom. Her love for travel took her to many places, each journey broadening her horizons and adding depth to her already rich life story.

Her love for us transcended generations. She was the first great-grandmother, a title she wore with pride. Her guidance and wisdom were invaluable, shaping our paths in ways that only a grandmother's love can. She was our confidante, our cheerleader, and our rock.

As we bid farewell to our beloved grandmother, let us carry her spirit within us. Let her love, her resilience, and her boundless kindness be the guiding lights in our lives. Though she has left this earthly realm, her presence will forever be felt in the hearts of all who had the privilege of knowing her.

In the words of Robert Louis Stevenson, "We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars." Grandma, you were always looking at the stars, and you taught us all to do the same. Rest in peace, our dear grandmother. You will be deeply missed, but never forgotten."""
    }
}

## Task

Evaluate the models based on the quality and relevance of their outputs, and select the model that generated the best output. Answer by providing the model identifier of the best model. We will use your output as the name of the best model, so make sure your output only contains one of the following model identifiers and nothing else (no quotes, no spaces, no new lines, ...): m or M.
